title: update_zshrc clobbers symlink + Linux cargo needs cc
description: Two gauntlet bugs: (1) update_zshrc curl -o $HOME/.zshrc replaces a symlinked ~/.zshrc with a standalone copy, silently reverting local commits -> make it git pull when ~/.zshrc symlinks into a git repo. (2) Linux cargo install bat/ripgrep fails with 'linker cc not found' in minimal containers -> queue build-essential in the apt batch when compiling.

title: Use fastfetch on macOS (neofetch successor)
description: neofetch upstream is archived/deprecated (2024). brew still installs it so macOS parity works today, but fastfetch is the maintained successor. Evaluate switching the neofetch dependency + the run() neofetch -L splash to fastfetch across both OSes.
close_reason: Replaced neofetch with fastfetch: brew install on macOS, official arch-aware .deb release on Linux (.deb URLs verified HTTP 200), splash now runs fastfetch. 45/45 bats GREEN; fastfetch 2.63.1 installed + rendering on host macOS.
